title: Canonical pro-etale projective-line decomposition and trace systems
statement: Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring in universe $u+1$, let $N>0$ annihilate $A$, and use schemes in universe $u$. Use the ordinary constant-module small-pro-etale derived objects, comparison functor, canonical source/exchange maps and trace $\operatorname{pr}_2b^{-1}$ of [def-sp-p1-comparison-arrows]. Put $q_S:P_S=\mathbf P^1_S\to S$ [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change], $U_S=A_S$ and $L_S=A_S(1)$. A Chern family consists of etale arrows $c_S:A_{P_S,et}\to A_{P_S,et}(1)[2]$ for every $S$ with $N$ invertible. A twisted family consists of isomorphisms $b_S:L_S[2]\oplus U_S\cong Rq_{S,*}L_{P_S}[2]$, and a decomposition family consists of arrows $d_S:U_S\oplus A_S(-1)[-2]\to Rq_{S,*}U_{P_S}$. Define the predicate on these three families by the following conditions, without asserting their existence. For every such $S$, the abelian realization of $c_S$ is the actual scalar Kummer class of $\mathcal O(1)$ of [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-kummer-class]; $d_S$ is invertible and is exactly the comparison transport of the unit-and-evaluation map of [def-sp-p1-decomposition-arrows], using $c_S$. The two components of $b_S$ are exactly the comparison transports of the normalized shifted unit and Chern adjunct of [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows], using the roots-normalized transport of [def-amb-p1-trace] and that same $c_S$. For every morphism $g:S'\to S$ between schemes with $N$ invertible, require the canonical exchange to carry $g^*d_S$ to $d_{S'}$, with the source comparison; also require $g^*\operatorname{Tr}_{q_S}$ to equal $\operatorname{Tr}_{q_{S'}}$ after the twisted exchange and constant pullback identification. These are the source, unit exchange and twist exchange maps of [def-sp-p1-comparison-arrows], using the normalized twist pullback of [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback]. Require the second component of $b_S$ followed by its trace to be $\operatorname{id}_{U_S}$. Finally, for every algebraically closed field $\Omega$ of universe $u$, with $N$ invertible, and every $\Omega$-rational section $x:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to\mathbf P^1_\Omega$, require the ideal of $x$ to be invertible and the abelian realization of $c_{\operatorname{Spec}\Omega}$ to equal the concrete Kummer Chern class of the dual ideal of $x$, as defined in [def-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer-boundary]. The base schemes and the morphisms in these conditions are arbitrary; no Noetherianity or flatness is required.
